meta.title: Assign a technical evaluator to a line item
gaps: Assert that the selected evaluator's name appears under the first line item; the case does not provide the user's name and no catalog step can assert an assigned evaluator name.

plan.title: Assign technical evaluator to line item

steps.note: Open the eRFX create flow needed for a technical stage with line items.
Provide the mandatory event title for a create test.
Create a technical stage alongside an RFQ stage so the event has line items and technical questionnaires.
Configure the technical stage before adding its questionnaire and evaluator.
Apply a template to the technical stage.
Move to the pricing stage where project line items are added.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the first line item that will receive the technical questionnaire and evaluator.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet so the line item is valid.
Return to the technical stage to configure the first line-item section.
Create and fill the technical questionnaire sections for the line item.
Assign an organizational user to each required technical evaluator control, including the first line item.
Verify that the evaluator assignment completed without an application error.
